subject.title: fix(nextcloud-talk): add timeouts to Talk send requests

question: Should Nextcloud Talk outbound message and reaction sends use a hard 30s default timeout, or should the plugin expose or reuse a configurable timeout policy before this PR merges?
rationale: The code change is mechanically sound, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for unusually slow self-hosted Talk servers from unbounded waiting to a 30s failure.

options.title: Accept 30s bounded failure
options.body: Merge as-is and treat hung or very slow outbound Talk sends as failures after 30s.

options.title: Require plugin timeout policy
options.body: Ask for a narrow configurable or documented timeout policy if operators must tune slow self-hosted sends.

recommendation.title: Accept 30s bounded failure
recommendation.body: Merge as-is and treat hung or very slow outbound Talk sends as failures after 30s.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and related bundled network-policy history make vincentkoc the best available owner for the timeout-default tradeoff.
